# CodeDAC

> CodeDAC is an independent developer of small utility apps for Android and Windows — floating tools that stay on top of other apps (notes, timers, calculator, crypto ticker, reading guide, clipboard), plus auto start, volume boost and on-device photo redaction. Every app is free to download with an optional Pro upgrade; pages are available in 21 languages.

## Android apps (Google Play)

- [Clipboard+](https://codedac.com/apps/clipboard.html): Clipboard history & manager. Copy, save, search and paste on phone or PC. Free vs Pro: Free keeps your text and image clipboard history with search, snippets, up to 3 groups, the floating panel, the widget and the selection-menu shortcut, and it shows ads. Pro removes the ads and adds phone-to-PC sync through your own Google Drive, unlimited image clips, the expanded floating panel and widget, unlimited groups, PDF export and backup restore — monthly, yearly or as a one-time lifetime purchase. If you need one of these for just a day, a short ad unlocks it for 24 hours. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.clipboard
- [AutoStart+](https://codedac.com/apps/autostart.html): Auto-launch your apps on boot. No root required, set once. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.autostart
- [FloatCalc+](https://codedac.com/apps/floatcalc.html): A floating calculator with FX and unit converters, on top of any app. Free vs Pro: The floating calculator is free for 60 minutes a day, and the panel's title bar shows how much of that is left. When you need more, watch a short ad for a 24-hour pass. Pro removes the daily time limit and the ads and adds the remaining unit categories and 30+ currencies, 7 premium themes and full panel customization (opacity, size, width), monthly, yearly or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.floatcalc
- [FloatCrypto+](https://codedac.com/apps/floatcrypto.html): A live crypto ticker floating over any app, with alerts and charts. Free vs Pro: Free follows 2 coins with 1 price alert and refreshes the ticker every 30 seconds. A Free Pass opens one feature for 24 hours in exchange for one short ad — the Chart pass unlocks the 7-day and 30-day charts, the Watchlist pass gives 10 coins and unlimited alerts — one of each per day, for as many days as you like, and ads keep running while a pass is active. Pro gives 10 coins, unlimited alerts, a 10-second refresh, the full chart history and no ads, monthly, annually or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.floatcrypto
- [FloatTimer+](https://codedac.com/apps/floattimer.html): A floating timer, counter and stopwatch that stays over any app. Free vs Pro: Unlimited timers, counters, and stopwatches, with no daily time limit. The only free limit is one floating overlay at a time — Pro shows as many as you like at once, or you can watch a short ad for a 24-hour Free Pass. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.floattimer
- [VolumeBooster+](https://codedac.com/apps/volumebooster.html): Volume booster, equalizer and bass boost — make any sound louder, up to +15 dB. Free vs Pro: Free gives you up to +10 dB, all 9 presets, the 5-band equalizer, the floating panel and AutoEQ for mainstream brands like Apple, Samsung, Sony, Bose, JBL and Beats — with free boosting limited to 60 minutes a day, resetting at midnight. A Free Pass adds 24 hours of Max Boost (the full +15 dB range with no daily limit) or AutoEQ (the complete headphone catalogue) for a single short ad, with no card and no trial to cancel. Pro unlocks the full range, unlimited boost time, every AutoEQ profile and the hearing protection dashboard, and removes ads — monthly, yearly or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.volumebooster
- [PhotoCleaner+](https://codedac.com/apps/photocleaner.html): Hide personal info in photos & PDFs, fully on-device. Free vs Pro: Three times a day. What counts is the Export button, whatever you do with the result: save, share, PDF or print. Detection, editing and masking are never capped. Pro removes the daily limit, and if you'd rather not subscribe, a short ad lifts it for 24 hours. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.photocleaner
- [ReadFocus+](https://codedac.com/apps/readfocus.html): A dyslexia & ADHD reading aid with line highlight & mask. Free vs Pro: Yes. The free version gives 60 minutes of overlay time per session and 3 color themes. Pro adds an ad-free experience, all 10 themes, and unlimited overlay time — and you can also watch a short rewarded ad to unlock any Pro feature free for 24 hours. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.readfocus
- [FloatNote+](https://codedac.com/apps/floatnote.html): Sticky notes that float over any app. Collapse to a chip, expand to a card, with colors and rich text. Free vs Pro: Yes. Saving notes is unlimited and free, and the free version floats one note at a time, gives you all 7 colors and shows ads. Pro adds unlimited floating notes, inline images, adjustable opacity, Google Drive sync, export and import, and removes ads. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.floatnote
- [Rotate+](https://codedac.com/apps/rotate.html): Force screen rotation for the whole phone or per app — portrait, landscape or auto. No root. Free vs Pro: All rotation modes, Keep orientation, Rotate once, tiles, widgets and shortcuts are free, along with 3 per-app rules and a small banner ad. Pro adds unlimited per-app rules, conditions that change the orientation automatically (while charging, with headphones, a Bluetooth device, a car or desk dock, during a call or at set times), a floating rotate button and no ads. Not ready to buy? Watch one ad for a 24-hour Free Pass of a Pro feature. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.rotate

## Windows apps (Microsoft Store)

- [Clipboard+ for Windows](https://codedac.com/apps/clipboardwin.html): A Windows tray clipboard manager that syncs with the Clipboard+ Android app. Free vs Pro: The clipboard history, snippets and groups, search, the quick-pick popup, and the light and dark themes are all free. Pro adds Google Drive sync, copying image clips back to the clipboard, PDF export, backup import, unlimited groups, and unlimited image storage — free image storage is capped at 50 MB. Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9N9SRKQV1R6D
- [ReadFocus+ for Windows](https://codedac.com/apps/readfocuswin.html): A click-through focus strip for Windows — Mask and Highlight keep your eyes on the line. Free vs Pro: Yes. The free version reads in sessions of up to 60 minutes and includes both reading modes and three of the ten themes. Pro is a one-time purchase — not a subscription — and adds premium themes, Focus Strip settings (height, opacity) and Keep Screen On, and removes the time limit. The Windows version has no ads. Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NMSHKKX3R5C
- [FloatNote+ for Windows](https://codedac.com/apps/floatnotewin.html): Sticky notes that float over any window on Windows, syncing with the FloatNote+ Android app. Free vs Pro: Yes. Writing and storing notes is free and unlimited, and the Windows version has no ads. The free version floats one note on screen at a time, with all seven colors. Pro is a one-time purchase — not a subscription — and adds unlimited floating notes, inline images, adjustable note transparency, Google Drive sync, and note export and import. Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NW6610397TC
- [FloatTimer+ for Windows](https://codedac.com/apps/floattimerwin.html): Timers, counters and stopwatches that float over any window on Windows as small pastel cards. Free vs Pro: Yes. You can make as many timers, counters and stopwatches as you like — the list is never limited — and the Windows version has no ads. The free version floats one card on screen at a time. Pro is a one-time purchase — not a subscription — and adds unlimited floating cards, repeating timers, any color you like, and your own alert sound or a full-screen alert. Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P3CTX3SXTGW
- [PhotoCleaner+ for Windows](https://codedac.com/apps/photocleanerwin.html): Hide personal info in photos, screenshots and PDFs on your PC before you share. Free vs Pro: Finding personal info is free and unlimited, and you can save, copy or share the masked copy of 3 documents a day for free. Pro is a one-time purchase that removes the daily limit and adds PDF export, printing, the always-hide list and your choice of mask color. There are no ads and no watermark, on either version. Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P22XH3N66VM
- [FloatCrypto+ for Windows](https://codedac.com/apps/floatcryptowin.html): A live crypto price ticker that floats over every window on Windows, with price alerts and charts. Free vs Pro: Free follows 2 coins with 1 price alert, refreshes every 30 seconds and shows the 1-day chart — and the ticker has no time limit. Pro is a one-time purchase that raises this to 10 coins, unlimited alerts, a 10-second refresh and the 7-day and 30-day charts. The Windows version has no ads. Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NMFCT755G24
